items.source: Build an error message for an CQL script execution failure, based on the supplied arguments.
items.translation: 根据提供的参数，构建一个 CQL 脚本执行失败的错误消息。

items.source: stmtNumber - the statement number in the CQL script (i.e., the nth statement present in the resource).
items.translation: stmtNumber - 在 CQL 脚本中的语句编号（即资源中存在的第 n 条语句）。

items.source: stmt - the actual CQL statement that failed.
items.translation: stmt - 实际失败的 CQL 语句。

items.source: Thrown by ScriptUtils if a statement in an CQL script failed when executing it against the target database.
items.translation: 由ScriptUtils抛出，当针对目标数据库执行CQL脚本中的语句失败时。

items.source: encodedResource - the resource from which the CQL statement was read.
items.translation: encodedResource - 读取 CQL 语句的资源。

items.source: encodedResource - the resource from which the CQL statement was read

items.source: an error message suitable for an exception's detail message or logging.
items.translation: 适用于异常详细信息消息或日志的错误消息。
